risk_note: RV2 by path (linking, plus the contract and its generated files for ingestEvents). Implements POST /v1/events (C-31 step 1, D10-1469 / 1470 / 1471 / 1535): x-auth optional, X-Device-Id required (missing header is rejected by the platform route schema, 20001, nothing written), version-gated, unsigned. The batch is accepted; each event is validated against specs/events.yaml and non-conforming ones are dropped one by one and counted in data.dropped_count; duplicates of (name, event_id) in a batch are kept once. link_jump writes link_open_attempts.jump_reported_at only for the caller's own token, an attempt the caller started, the attempt's own link_id, and result requested or unknown (failed never): UPDATE ... WHERE id, user_id, link_id, app_id match AND jump_reported_at IS NULL, time from the injected Clock; later or repeated reports never change it (also guarded by the existing write-once trigger). Every other event is accepted and not stored in this step (events table is CT-13e/f/g/h). The contract only drops ingestEvents' x-implementation: planned; regenerated files changed: planned-operations.gen.ts and route-schemas.gen.ts. Also fixes two comments that pointed at approvals #26 (FU-LINKING-COMMENT-AP26). No money, ledger or migration change; no new table writes besides the one column.
